---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or extension for the project
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Summary

Describe the proposed feature or improvement.

## Motivation

Explain why this feature would be useful for the project.

## Proposed Approach

Describe how this could be implemented.

## Research Considerations

Mention any methodological issues, assumptions, or risks.

Examples:

- Look-ahead bias
- Survivorship bias
- Transaction costs
- Multiple testing
- Data availability
- Model stability

## Expected Output

Describe the expected result, such as:

- New module
- New notebook
- New report
- New visualization
- New test
